Security.//: Phase 20 hardening. AllowedOrigins lists the local SPAs (customer :4200, admin :4300). Empty = same-origin only.

Performance.//: Phase 22. Response compression (Brotli/Gzip) for JSON + output caching for anonymous catalog reads.

ResponseCompression.//EnableForHttps: Off by default (BREACH; a TLS proxy usually compresses). Turn on only if understood.

Observability.//OtlpEndpoint: Set to http://localhost:4317 to export traces/metrics/logs to the compose 'observability' profile (Jaeger). Empty disables OTLP export.

//Secrets: No secrets live in this file. Set ConnectionStrings:Postgres, Identity:Jwt:SigningKey, Payments:WebhookSecret and RabbitMq:Password with `dotnet user-secrets` (see docs/deployment.md).
